"""Retain compact development evidence without raw logs or private paths."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess

task = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repo = task.parents[2]
checks = task / 'setup1-review/checks'


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def public_text(text):
    replacements = [(str(task), '<task>'), (str(repo), '<repo>'),
                    (str(repo.parents[1] / '.rustup/toolchains/1.85.1-aarch64-apple-darwin'), '<rust-1.85.1>'),
                    ('/' + 'projectnb/welfgr/fereg/runs/cmg-upgrade-20261021', '<scc-task>')]
    for old, new in replacements:
        text = text.replace(old, new)
    return text


diagnoses = {
    'policy-remaining-unit-1': 'A retained routing test call lacked the new successor flag/sidecar arguments; migrated to false/None.',
    'policy-calibration-parser-1': 'Test fixture omitted required platform metadata; corrected the fixture.',
    'policy-remaining-integration-1': 'Test expected the wrong existing unsupported-request error variant; changed expectation to InvalidArgument without changing production behavior.',
    'policy-full-suite-1': '315 Python tests passed, then existing installed-plugin binding failed. Release artifacts were not changed; package admission remains failed.',
    'policy-source-suite-1': 'New test failed Clippy manual-range-contains; replaced the equivalent assertion with RangeInclusive::contains.',
    'policy-source-suite-2': 'Runtime, Clippy, fuzz, FFI and portable checks passed; complexity inventory was stale. Reviewed scoped growth and refreshed the inventory. Later mock-bridge checks were not reached.',
    'policy-source-suite-3': 'Core suite retained 1406 passed, 1 failed, 3 ignored. Existing incremental_two_injection_builds_installs_and_certifies_uncapped_cmg failed; the exact internal assertion was not printed. A deterministic independent witness later demonstrated nested cached-worker TLS overwrite, but the historical assertion/cause remains unproven.',
    'policy-callsite-unit-1': 'New test used a nonexistent into_design API; corrected to the existing prepared borrowed binding.',
    'policy-bench-suite-1': '352 discovered tests; two import failures because private test environment lacked psutil.',
    'policy-test-dependency-1': 'Sandbox network could not resolve package index. Authorized network retry installed the same dependency in the task-private environment.',
    'policy-bench-suite-2': '360 discovered tests; two import failures because private test environment lacked matplotlib.',
    'policy-campaign-dependency-retest-1': 'Two import failures because private test environment lacked ReportLab.',
}
mutation = json.loads((task / 'policy-callsite-witness-review.json').read_text())
for item in mutation['mutants']:
    diagnoses[item['label']] = 'Expected discriminating mutation failure: ' + item['discrimination']

records = []
for path in sorted(checks.glob('policy-*.json')):
    value = json.loads(path.read_text())
    log = path.with_suffix('.log')
    assert sha(log) == value['log_sha256']
    text = log.read_text(errors='replace')
    record = {key: value[key] for key in ('label', 'exit', 'elapsed_s', 'log_sha256')}
    record['command'] = [public_text(item) for item in value['command']]
    record['environment'] = value['environment']
    record['before_head'] = value['before']['head'].strip()
    record['after_head'] = value['after']['head'].strip()
    record['source_vector_before_sha256'] = value['before'].get('source_vector_sha256')
    record['source_vector_after_sha256'] = value['after'].get('source_vector_sha256')
    record['tracked_diff_before_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(value['before']['diff'].encode()).hexdigest()
    record['tracked_diff_after_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(value['after']['diff'].encode()).hexdigest()
    record['python_test_counts'] = [int(n) for n in re.findall(r'^Ran (\d+) tests? in ', text, re.M)]
    record['rust_test_groups'] = [dict(zip(('passed', 'failed', 'ignored', 'measured', 'filtered'), map(int, match)))
                                  for match in re.findall(r'test result: (?:ok|FAILED)\. (\d+) passed; (\d+) failed; (\d+) ignored; (\d+) measured; (\d+) filtered out;', text)]
    if record['exit']:
        assert record['label'] in diagnoses, record['label']
        record['diagnosis'] = diagnoses[record['label']]
    records.append(record)

final = json.loads((checks / 'policy-source-suite-4.json').read_text())
assert final['exit'] == 0
assert final['before']['source_vector_sha256'] == final['after']['source_vector_sha256']
bench = json.loads((checks / 'policy-bench-suite-3.json').read_text())
assert bench['exit'] == 0
names = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-files', '--modified', '--others', '--exclude-standard'], cwd=repo, text=True).splitlines()
sources = {name: sha(repo / name) for name in sorted(names)
           if not name.startswith('bench/results/') and (repo / name).is_file()}
source = Path(__file__).read_text()
record = {
    'schema': 1, 'date': '2026-10-21',
    'purpose': 'Hidden remaining-cost policy foundation and prospective calibration tools; no fitted coefficients or public activation.',
    'base_revision': final['before']['head'].strip(),
    'accepted_native_revision': '1cdb225e2460e391ad38f856755ae3ea5efb2e5b',
    'cmg_revision': 'fd77d98da1f74009b3e5b634e1944433b647a9b1',
    'specification': 'docs/two_fe_auto_policy.md',
    'source_files_sha256': sources,
    'final_check_source_vector_sha256': final['before']['source_vector_sha256'],
    'checks': records,
    'mutation_review_sha256': sha(task / 'policy-callsite-witness-review.json'),
    'mutation_review': mutation,
    'independent_review': {
        'high_effort': 'Reviewed ownership, arithmetic, disjoint labels, actual worker admission, bounded future grouping, calibration matching, fitting and full fake 864-call runner; completed deterministic cached-worker TLS overwrite witness and bounded subprocess isolation of four affected tests.',
        'astra': 'Reviewed formula/fit and runtime integration, then implemented four real callsite witnesses and killed all four actual callsite mutants; original source restored byte-for-byte.',
        'limitations': 'Independent source review and synthetic/analytic checks do not establish native integration, calibration support, prediction accuracy or performance qualification.'
    },
    'known_failures': {
        'installed_package_binding': 'Failed; source-only validation does not replace package admission. Distribution packages remain unchanged.',
        'historical_h16_assertion': 'The exact failing internal assertion in source-suite-3 remains unknown. Demonstrated TLS overwrite and later isolated passes do not erase or conclusively explain that failure.',
        'unlogged_operations': [
            {'operation': 'initial cargo fmt invocation', 'exit': 101, 'log_sha256': None, 'reason': 'Pinned cargo executable used without its toolchain directory on PATH; corrected PATH invocation passed.'},
            {'operation': 'read-only local process inspection', 'exit': None, 'log_sha256': None, 'reason': 'Sandbox denied ps. No workload or artifact was changed.'}
        ]
    },
    'complexity': json.loads((repo / 'tests/reference/complexity.json').read_text())['inventory']['metrics'],
    'hygiene': {'completed_setup_cleanup_sha256': sha(task / 'policy/completed-setup-cleanup.json'),
                'completed_setup_cleanup': json.loads((task / 'policy/completed-setup-cleanup.json').read_text())},
    'limits': ['Timing values in check records are command durations, not performance measurements.',
               'Rust groups include isolated child test processes and zero-match integration binaries; their sum is not a unique-test count.',
               'Earlier checks predate the untracked-source-vector wrapper enhancement; null source vectors are unavailable, not verified.',
               'All failures are retained. No calibration or held-out native panel has run at this boundary. Public DEFAULT_TWO remains false and CALIBRATION remains None.',
               'Native audit/ABI/load/panic, exact old/outside-scope replay and mapped Stata/transaction checks belong to the next stable-artifact integration boundary.'],
    'retention_tool': {'sha256': hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest(), 'source': source}
}
output = public_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2, sort_keys=True)) + '\n'
for name in ('Users/', 'projectnb/', 'usr4/', 'private/var/', 'var/folders/'):
    forbidden = '/' + name
    assert forbidden not in output, forbidden
assert len(output.encode()) < 1_000_000
path = repo / 'bench/results/two-fe-policy-development-20261021.json'
path.write_text(output)
print(path.name, len(output.encode()), sha(path))
